position: r_body = position_sensor - position_navigation_reference; expressed in body axes
rotation_mapping: v_body = R_body_sensor * v_sensor; R_transpose_R = I; det(R) = +1
angular_velocity: omega_x, omega_y, omega_z are right-hand positive; axial rocket roll is about +Z
qualification: project_convention; not a claim of NASA certification or active lever-arm compensation

notation.body_axes: unsubscripted x,y,z; legacy X,Y,Z denotes the same body axes
notation.navigation_axes: E,N,U; use n when a frame superscript is required
notation.sensor_native_axes: x_s_i,y_s_i,z_s_i in the distinct sensor-native frame s_i for instance i
notation.installation_vector: r_i^b: sensor point i relative to navigation O, expressed in common body axes; device subscript identifies the point, not a different axis triad
notation.gnss_measurement: p_gnss_i^n in ENU, or explicitly declared ECEF; never assume an invented GNSS body triad
notation.serialized_compatibility: position_body_m.x/y/z and existing ABI names remain stable; vector frames are explicit and never inferred from letter case
